title: Final Potential Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the electrostatic potential due to the dipole and the conducting sphere must be provided.

title: Field Description
description: Essential Criteria: A qualitative description of the resulting fields from the two isolated conducting spheres in the uniform electric field must be included.

title: Image Charge Method
description: Important Criteria: The application of the method of images to find the potential must be clearly demonstrated.

title: Dipole Approximation
description: Important Criteria: The use of dipole approximation for the fields due to the conducting spheres must be correctly explained.

title: Limitations Acknowledged
description: Optional Criteria: Any assumptions or limitations of the approximations used should be acknowledged.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign errors in the expressions for the image charges or dipole moments must be avoided.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: All units in the final expressions must be consistent and correctly applied.
